items.quote: We continue to maintain our guidance on keeping credit costs under check and below 25 bps on a sustainable basis
items.statement: Credit cost to remain below 25 bps on a sustainable basis
items.speaker: Manu Singh

items.quote: Our aspiration clearly is to consistently deliver 20%-plus AUM growth
items.statement: Aspiration of consistent AUM growth of 20%-plus
items.speaker: Manu Singh

items.quote: We're very confident to maintain the spreads 5%+.
items.speaker: Ghanshyam Rawat

items.quote: it will be somewhere 2.75% opex to AUM ratio
items.statement: Opex to AUM ratio of about 2.75% once balance sheet doubles
items.speaker: Ghanshyam Rawat

items.quote: As a management team, we want to keep control at less than 6%.
items.statement: Balance transfer to peer group to be kept below 6%
items.speaker: Ghanshyam Rawat

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management says it is very confident of maintaining spreads above 5% and sets a 20%-plus AUM growth aspiration, while acknowledging that opex-to-AUM improvement depends on growth returning.
